prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single transparent PNG match-3 game piece, 1024 x 1024 square.
Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for the approved Bold Cartoon rendering style, purple palette, outline weight and game-piece scale. Do NOT draw a butterfly.
Create ONE friendly PURPLE ROYAL CROWN that replaces the butterfly as the purple match piece in a royal storybook game. Compact front-facing crown with three chunky rounded points, taller central point, two shorter side points, and a broad curved base band. The crown is strongly purple (at least 85% of its visible colour): vivid violet main face, lavender highlight plane and deep purple base band. A thin warm gold line along the base may be used sparingly, but the piece must read as PURPLE, never yellow. No large jewels or extra symbols.
Match the reference style exactly: bold consistent dark indigo outer outline, rounded joins, simple flat cel shading in 2–3 solid tones, one small crisp light-lavender graphic highlight. Cheerful confident shapes, broad readable silhouette at 32 pixels. No 3D, no facets, no brush texture, no airbrush gradients, no eyes, no face, no writing.
Center the whole crown in the square with transparent padding, occupying approximately 78% of the width and 65% of the height. No cropping, no other objects, no background scene, no pedestal, no shadow on a surface, no decorative sparkles.
The background MUST be real transparent RGBA alpha=0. Do not draw a checkerboard, white fill or black fill. Deliver a cutout PNG containing only the purple crown.
referenceRole: Rendering style and purple colour only; butterfly replaced with royal crown
